name: madhurai-chocolate-platform
description: Production Ready Two-Website E-Commerce System for Madhurai Chocolate

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,CUSTOMER,ADMIN" -c "magenta,blue,green" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:customer" "npm run dev:admin"
scripts.build: npm run build:customer && npm run build:admin
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix customer-web install && npm --prefix admin-web install
